remarks: Just completed rental! This sought-after new community of 11 luxury homes is completely sold out! Only 1 rental available. Take advantage of new construction, walkability, quiet cul de sac location on a private lane, easy commuting and walking path to Trader Joe's, the High Ridge shopping plaza with Starbucks, restaurants, shops and more. High ceilings throughout the home, Marvin windows, natural Oak hardwood floors, modern trimwork, professional appliances and high-end fixtures and finishes. The open floor plan features a spacious kitchen with Quartz tops, center island, butlers pantry to formal dining room and open to spacious family room with fireplace and sliders to the rear patio. Formal living room or office, pantry, mudroom, powder room and 2-car garage complete this level. The second floor boasts 4 bedrooms including a luxe primary bedroom with 2 WICs, gorgeous full bath with freestanding tub and shower. The finished lower level includes full bath and expansive recreation room. Walk up finished third floor offers a ton of storage. Don't miss this rare opportunity to experience a new home with a highly desirable floor plan on a quiet cul de sac. Ready for August 1 occupancy (or possibly earlier). Landlord prefers one year or more rental. Pets - landlord may consider small dog.
